name: Harper Mobile Spike
description: Instrumented on-device spike testing the write-eviction hypothesis: an engine-free (no WASM) build whose content script is SILENT — it buffers its whole trail in memory and posts nothing until a single batched flush at t=45s (then t=90s), so the background performs no note-writes while an editor is open until that flush. Proves whether background data.put note-writes are what evict the mobile editor. Not for publication.
author: pmslava
